$comment: Lane standard-db: files under supabase/, nothing under web/ or extension/, no new UI, and nothing touching the privacy invariants, RLS, grants, auth, the issue state machine or evidence closure (those are full). The full plan without ux-designer, ux-auditor and frontend-engineer; ux-writer runs beside backend-engineer for user-visible strings (errors, templates) and copy blocks engineering-lead (design-v2 sections 4 and 13, actio-orchestration Lanes). When no user-visible string changes, delete the ux-writer entry, the copy gate, copy from engineering-lead's blocked_by and the two strings files from its consumes, and record it in out_of_scope.
lane_reason: <orchestrator: why this lane, from the files the change touches>
out_of_scope: ux-designer: lane standard-db, no new UI, so there is no surface to specify and no string-slots.json
ux-auditor: lane standard-db, no design spec to audit
frontend-engineer: lane standard-db, nothing under web/ or extension/ changes
gate design: its owner ux-auditor is not in the standard-db plan
ux-writer works from the strings tech-architect names in brief-backend.md, beside backend-engineer, because there are no slots from a designer

plan.task: Regression brief: node .actio/bin/bugs.mjs brief for this run's surfaces, then judgement lines for patterns the tag maps missed. One slice per agent in the plan.
<orchestrator: this run's architecture task> Write the ADR and brief-backend.md (no front-end brief in this lane), naming every user-visible string the change adds or alters.
accept: The brief names its inputs, outputs, acceptance criteria and every user-visible string
The ADR confirms no privacy invariant, RLS, grant, auth, state machine or evidence rule is touched, or sends the run to lane full

plan.task: <orchestrator: the schema and function work> Hand-authored forward-only migrations, pgTAP, and the written reverse of every migration in reverse.md.
accept: npm run db:test green, its log under evidence/backend/
Every migration has its written reverse in backend-engineer/reverse.md

plan.task: English and Arabic for every user-visible string brief-backend.md names (errors, WhatsApp and SMS templates), beside backend-engineer. Arabic marked needs native review. The copy gate certifies the final catalogue (shipped as content/strings/{en,ar}.json).
accept: Every named string has English and Arabic, Arabic marked needs native review
No number without its sample size, no status without its written label

plan.task: Senior review of backend-engineer's change at the latest snapshot: problem fit, layer boundaries, failure modes, test quality, rollout safety. Independent of the other three reviews.

Line-by-line defect, data-layer and structural scan of backend-engineer's change at the latest snapshot: migrations, policies, grants, definer functions, Edge Functions. Independent of the other three reviews.
Readability and maintainability review of backend-engineer's change at the latest snapshot: names, size, migration and function headers, comments that say why. Independent of the other three reviews.

Security sweep of backend-engineer's change at the latest snapshot per actio-security: RLS on every client-reachable table, grants, definer functions, secrets, the Supabase advisors. Independent of the three reviews.
Regression guard: node .actio/bin/bugs.mjs guard for this run on the maker's snapshot. Runs beside the four reviews, not after them; re-run on each new snapshot.

Integration gate: node .actio/bin/verify.mjs once for the snapshot, conformance to the ADR, migrate, check the strings ux-writer wrote are the ones the database and functions return, get_advisors clean or accepted in writing.
Test the change: API contract, privacy invariants still holding, state machine, error strings in all four locales. Reuse the verify bundle for the same tree. Evidence under evidence/qc/.
Audit qc-engineer's evidence, name the untested surface, probe the highest blast-radius path yourself, and issue go or no-go as the quality gate.

Release: pre-flight, rollback.md before the first migration, migrations through the Supabase MCP verified with list_migrations, get_advisors clean, build green, tag, push to origin main, post-release smoke. Hosting recorded as deferred: no target chosen.
Record pass: every product-code defect from this run into BUGS.md with its standing rule; ids from bugs.mjs next-id, the Open index from bugs.mjs open-index.
